# settle402

> Batch settlement for x402 micro-payments via Multicall3

settle402 batches hundreds of signed EIP-3009 `transferWithAuthorization` payloads and submits them on-chain in a single transaction via Multicall3, amortizing gas across the entire batch.

Hosted API: https://api.settle402.dev
Landing page: https://settle402.dev

## API

Base URL: https://api.settle402.dev

### POST /keys
Generate a new API key. No auth required.
Returns: {"key": "s402_..."}

### POST /settle
Submit a batch of EIP-3009 authorizations for on-chain settlement.
Auth: X-Settler-Token header with API key.
Body: {"authorizations": [{authorization, signature, payer, amount}]}
Optional fields: network, chainId, tokenContract, feeAuthorization.
Returns: {status, total_submitted, total_succeeded, total_failed, total_gas_used, results}

### GET /health
Liveness check. Returns: {status, chain_id, settler}

### GET /status
Settler address, ETH balance, chain ID, lifetime stats.

## Integration

MCP servers accumulate x402 micro-payments in-memory and POST batches to settle402 when the threshold is reached. Example with Octomil:

```
OCTOMIL_X402_ADDRESS=0xYourWallet \
OCTOMIL_SETTLER_TOKEN=s402_... \
octomil mcp serve --x402
```

## Details

- Chain: Base (8453) by default, supports Ethereum, Polygon, Arbitrum, Optimism
- Token: USDC (EIP-3009 transferWithAuthorization)
- Max 1,000 authorizations per batch
- Sub-batches of 400 per on-chain transaction
- Fee: $0.10/batch (on-chain, atomic via feeAuthorization with allowFailure=false)
- Uses pre-deployed Multicall3 (0xcA11bde05977b3631167028862bE2a173976CA11)
